533:t_011:3.en:
$$スザク$$
「Maybe it's because of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$'s songs.」

533:t_011:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units! We're going on the offensive now!」

533:t_011:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll take on the Empire and $$マーティアル$$ together! BOMBER!!」

533:t_011:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, you guys! Every last one of you, listen to my soooong!!」

533:t_013:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The enemy's wiped out, and he's still singing...」

533:t_013:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「His energy is bottomless. That's $$熱気バサラ$$.」

533:t_013:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is not just $$バサラ$$. All of us hold infinite power within.」

533:t_013:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is what will lead us to an infinite future.」

533:t_013:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Infinite power and an infinite future... That isn't a bad phrase.」

533:t_013:5.en:
$$オルソン$$
「At least, I prefer that to the future the collective unconscious showed us.」

533:t_013:6.en:
$$レド$$
「So everyone... was shown the future in those ruins after all.」

533:t_013:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... It seems coming here was worthwhile...」

533:t_014:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「So this is the warmth of life... I understand a little of what my brother is trying to do now...」

533:t_014:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Thank you, $c. But be prepared: there will be no next time.」

533:t_015:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「So she's $$尸刻$$ of the $$鬼宿$$...」

533:t_015:1.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Apparently that woman... can drain the power of life by singing, the opposite of $$バサラ$$.」

533:t_015:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So that's the $$鬼宿$$, who turn the force of departing lives into their own power...」

533:t_016:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So $$マーティアル$$ came here to destroy the ruins...」

533:t_016:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even so, their timing's a little too good, showing up while we're here.」

533:t_016:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We should assume there is some intent behind this.」

533:t_016:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
(So he has started to move...)

533:t_100:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I have no more doubts...! No matter what I face, I will keep moving forward!)

533:t_100:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Watch closely, $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$! I am $$ゼロ$$... the man who creates miracles!)

533:t_101:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(And now he intends to twist our fate again...)

533:t_102:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You sing more too! Set your soul on fire!」

533:t_102:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Our songs are different from yours.」

533:t_102:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But... I do not dislike your songs.」

533:t_103:0.en:
$n
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$... Why on earth did you appear before us...?)

533:t_103:1.en:
$n
(I don't understand... $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... or $$マキ#pilot$$...)
